# Database Connection Failure

If the database is unavailable, it raises a DatabaseUnavailableError when attempting to establish a session for compiling. This situation can lead to failure in any operation reliant on database access.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._locked_session`
